fields.summary_ko.0: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress raised FY28 revenue growth guidance from 70% to 75%, sending stock surging in after-hours trading with Nasdaq-100 futures up 1.4%.
fields.summary_ko.1: S&P 500 fell 1%, Nasdaq-100 declined 0.7%, and Dow dropped 1.6% during regular session but rebounded in after-hours trading, with semiconductor ETF (SMH) rising approximately 4%.
fields.summary_ko.2: Nvidia's solid guidance confirmed sustained AI demand and eased capex concerns, with Anthropic IPO scheduled for Thursday listing.
